visual_description: The image displays the logo of the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD). On the left is a dark blue globe showing parts of Europe, Africa, and Asia. To its right are two stylized chevrons pointing rightward, followed by the acronym "OECD" in bold, dark blue capital letters. The entire logo is set against a solid yellow background.

The image shows a flooded rural road under an overcast sky. A yellow centerline runs down the middle of the asphalt, partially submerged by floodwater that extends across the entire roadway and into adjacent fields. Trees and utility poles line both sides of the road, with their lower trunks and bases underwater. Power lines stretch overhead on wooden poles. The water surface reflects the cloudy sky and surrounding vegetation. No charts, tables, diagrams, labels, or numerical data are present in the image.
